items.description: The list of test steps. Each step should be an object containing `inline` or `testCase`. **They should only include one of these fields at a time**.

An instruction to be followed as part of a step-by-step test script. The test step can have either an inline definition, or delegate execution to another test case. One of these options must be specified.

customFields.description:
Multi-line text fields support HTML and should denote new lines with the \<br\> tag.
Dates should be in the format 'yyyy-MM-dd'.
Users should have values of Jira User Account IDs.

expectedResult.description: The expected outcome of executing the instruction

reflectRef.description: The AI reference. Zephyr only feature

testData.description: Any test data required to perform the instruction (optional). The fields values provided can be interpolated into the description.

parameters.description: The list of parameters of the call to test step

type.description: Type of the parameter. It is manual inputs for parameters or the default values.

self.description: The REST API endpoint to get more resource details.

testCaseKey.description: The key of the other test case that the test step should delegate execution to. This cannot be the parent test case.

mode.description:
Valid values: `"APPEND"`, `"OVERWRITE"`.
`OVERWRITE` deletes and recreates the test steps and associated custom field values using the provided input. Attachments for existing steps are kept, but those for missing steps are deleted permanently
`APPEND` only adds extra steps to your test steps.

testCaseKey.description: The key of the test case. Test case keys are of the format [A-Z]+-T[0-9]+

name: zephyr_create_test_case_steps
title: Zephyr: Create Test Case Steps
